metadata.database: A Deeper China | Chengdu point decision layer

guest_name_map.CD002: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
guest_name_map.CD003: Panda Base versus Dujiangyan Panda Valley decision
guest_name_map.CD012: Sichuan snacks and tea low-commitment layer

CD001.guest_value: Give the visitor one public-space lens on sitting, watching and shared time.
CD001.choose_rule: Use as a time block, not a promise of a particular tea table or performance.
CD001.stop_after: The guest has observed the city rhythm without staging strangers.

CD002.guest_value: Answer the panda question without allowing it to define the whole city.
CD002.choose_rule: Use only after reservation, identity, weather and crowd plan are checked.
CD002.stop_after: The planned conservation/animal question and exit are complete.

CD003.guest_value: Make city convenience versus a wider day-trip purpose explicit.
CD003.choose_rule: Choose only after city time, transport tolerance and Dujiangyan intent are clear.
CD003.stop_after: One panda setting is selected with a realistic day length.

CD004.guest_value: Offer a religious and neighbourhood texture beyond retail streets.
CD004.choose_rule: Use for slow travel or religion interest and explain worship etiquette.
CD004.stop_after: One calm cultural reading is complete.

CD005.guest_value: Separate Three Kingdoms memory from a lively commercial street.
CD005.choose_rule: Choose by history depth or evening energy; do not call Jinli automatically authentic.
CD005.stop_after: The guest’s selected history/streets question is answered.

CD006.guest_value: Offer literary memory and garden scale for a quieter cultural reading.
CD006.choose_rule: Use instead of, not in addition to, every other history site.
CD006.stop_after: One poetry or garden question has become legible.

CD007.guest_value: Make the famous-street trade-off explicit for first-time visitors.
CD007.choose_rule: Opt in only if recognisable streets or shopping fit the brief.
CD007.stop_after: The guest decides the commercial/historic mix is worthwhile.

CD008.guest_value: Read consumer and youth-facing Chengdu as current city energy, not a shopping recommendation.
CD008.choose_rule: Include only for an explicit contemporary-city question.
CD008.stop_after: One public or consumer-space pattern is understood.

CD009.guest_value: Potentially connect industrial memory with tea or performance formats.
CD009.choose_rule: No specific show or venue until programme, language and return route are verified.
CD009.stop_after: The current programme adds a real contemporary question.

CD010.guest_value: Choose a performance by form, ambience and language fit, not by face-changing cliché alone.
CD010.choose_rule: Ask whether the guest wants theatrical form, spectacle, tea-house ambience or an English-led evening.
CD010.stop_after: One performance structure and a safe return plan are clear.

CD011.guest_value: Explain shared decision-making, spice and meal format rather than rank restaurants.
CD011.choose_rule: Collect spice, meat, allergy, shared-pot and queue requirements before recommending a format.
CD011.stop_after: One safe, understood meal is complete.

CD012.guest_value: Offer smaller food commitments when hotpot or shared pot is not a fit.
CD012.choose_rule: Use explicit dietary uncertainty; never call a dish safe without confirmation.
CD012.stop_after: One snack/tea format is understood and safely completed.

CD013.guest_value: Make water engineering and long infrastructure the purpose of a day trip.
CD013.choose_rule: Keep separate from a Panda Base half-day unless full logistics are verified.
CD013.stop_after: The engineering question and return plan are complete.

CD014.guest_value: Offer a mountain/Taoist extension only to guests who want the physical and cultural day.
CD014.choose_rule: Use only after fitness, season, weather and transport are confirmed.
CD014.stop_after: The mountain purpose is clear; do not add it as scenery filler.

CD015.guest_value: Protect the first Chengdu evening from payment, data and jet-lag failure.
CD015.choose_rule: Build from arrival time, hotel area and payment/data readiness.
CD015.stop_after: The visitor is connected, paid and rested enough for the next anchor.

CD016.guest_value: Provide a constrained two-day skeleton without pretending to cover everything.
CD016.choose_rule: Use one panda-or-cultural anchor per day plus tea/food time.
CD016.stop_after: The guest has a workable reservation order and recovery window.

CD017.guest_value: Use four days for city rhythm plus one deliberate day-trip decision.
CD017.choose_rule: Choose Dujiangyan or a second cultural layer; do not add both automatically.
CD017.stop_after: Each extra day answers a different question.

CD018.guest_value: Frame Chengdu and Chongqing as dwelling versus vertical intensity.
CD018.choose_rule: Require sequence and minimum nights in each city; output a handoff, not a bundle.
CD018.stop_after: The visitor accepts the transfer and the different city questions.

CD019.guest_value: Validate a Chengdu plan centred on tea, food, literature and public life.
CD019.choose_rule: Use when the guest explicitly does not need pandas; do not create fear of missing out.
CD019.stop_after: The visitor has a coherent non-panda city question.

CD020.guest_value: Keep Chengdu productive when humidity or rain makes long outdoor plans poor.
CD020.choose_rule: Hold as an uncommitted alternative until date-specific weather and opening rules are checked.
CD020.stop_after: The visitor has recovered and retained the day’s cultural question.
